name: Daniel Basco
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 2B

items.text: Daniel Basco is a data scientist and policy analyst. He holds a PhD in policy analysis from the RAND School of Public Policy. He advised the U.S. Department of Education under the Obama administration on science education funding and builds technology at Kindsight to help nonprofits find donors. He says Illinois' Evidence-Based Funding law requires the state to give Chicago Public Schools roughly $1 billion more per year. He wants the board to adopt multiyear budgets. He says the district should only use artificial intelligence when research demonstrates a clear benefit to students, and he supports stronger safeguards for student data. He backs expanding mental health services, including counselors and social workers.
